description: A friendly snowman made from three rounded, hand-packed snowballs stacked vertically: a wide base, a smaller middle, and a round head. The body is slightly lumpy and uneven, as though packed by hand from soft snow. Thin stick arms extend from the sides. The face is broad and cheerful, with dark coal eyes, a smiling coal mouth, and a long carrot nose pointing outward. A tall black top hat sits on the head, giving the otherwise soft, rounded silhouette a distinctive, playful outline. To be constructed procedurally in OpenSCAD.

message: Classified as 'imported' (not yet implemented). Although the snowman's three main body sections could nominally be represented as spheres, the full assembly — with its lumpy/uneven hand-packed snow texture, coal eyes, coal mouth (multiple small pieces), long carrot nose, thin irregular stick arms, and a tall top hat — requires far more than 2–6 single-primitive parts and includes organic, irregular surface detail (lumpy snow texture, hand-packed unevenness) that a simple CSG/primitive script cannot reasonably approximate. The request explicitly calls for organic character detail that goes beyond a clean primitive assembly. An imported, pre-modeled asset is the appropriate class. 1 candidate(s) found -- approve one in the review app (match confidence 0.25 < 0.5; match not specific enough for unattended download; no real-world size stated).
